- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Carnegie Mellon University (CMU) established the School of Computer Science (SCS) in 1965.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] CMU's Artificial Intelligence (AI) program was formed in 1972.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Robotics Institute was founded in 1982.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Human-Computer Interaction Institute was created in 1991.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Institute for Software Research was established in 1996.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Language Technologies Institute was formed in 2004.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] CMU began offering a Bachelor of Science degree in artificial intelligence in 2018.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The impact of SCS includes the production of companies like Siri, Nuance, and Mosaic.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Robotics Institute has contributed to autonomous systems and robotics in manufacturing and medical applications.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Human-Computer Interaction Institute has influenced user-friendly technology design.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Institute for Software Research has contributed to agile software development methodologies.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Notable alumni from CMU include founders of Google, LinkedIn, and MongoDB.
